description: SL Verkehrsnetze OKSTRA - Status des Elements - OGC API Features is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This service provides data implemented for the INSPIRE topic Transport Networks from the OKSTRA data model.:Status of a transport element with regard to its completion and use. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE-WFS SL Traffic networks OKSTRA - Status of the element - OGC API Features" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, Status des Elements, OKSTRA, INSPIRE-WFS_SL_OKSTRA, verkehrswesen, Geofachdaten. The listing shows 2025-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
